questions.stem: The following are true about treatment of myasthenia gravis:
questions.stemHtml: The following are true about treatment of myasthenia gravis:

options.label: A
options.text: Thymectomy is indicated in the absence of thymoma

options.label: B
options.text: Routine use of glucocorticoids is not indicated

options.label: C
options.text: Immunosuppressants like azathioprine are used only in myasthenic crisis

options.label: D
options.text: MuSK positive patients go into complete remission with thymectomy
